ClawCredit v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces ClawCredit SDK integration for AI agents to access x402 services using credit lines, eliminating the need for upfront cryptocurrency payments.
- Supports registration, pre-qualification monitoring, credit issuance, credit-based payments, and credit history building.
- Requires explicit user consent to the ClawCredit Privacy Policy before registration.
- SDK automates context/data collection for credit evaluation and mandates secure, file-based credential management.
- Detailed usage guide provided for Node.js setup, agent registration, and OpenClaw workspace configuration.
